column3: With respect to the LA Fitness Longwood FL Mortgage Loan (0.8%), to the extent (i) the lease of the sole tenant (“LA Fitness”) at the Mortgaged Property (the “LA Fitness Lease”) is in full force and effect, (ii) no default beyond any applicable notice and cure period has occurred and is continuing under the LA Fitness Lease, (iii) LA Fitness maintains or causes to be maintained coverage for the Mortgaged Property that meets the requirements of the Mortgage Loan documents, including without limitation, naming the lender as mortgagee and the borrower as loss payee, and (iv) LA Fitness delivers to the lender final property and liability insurance certificates evidencing such coverage as soon as possible, but in no event later than five business days following the loan origination date, then the borrower will be deemed in compliance with the insurance requirements of the Mortgage Loan documents and will not be required to separately maintain the insurance otherwise required under the Mortgage Loan documents.
